name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the following first-order linear ODE for the function $y=y(x):$

$$
x\cdot \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+2y=1
$$

Write the equation in the form $\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(yI(x))=I(x)Q(x),$ where $I(x)$ is an integrating factor.

Question 2
?

Consider the following first-order linear ODE for the function y=y(x): x⋅dydx+2y=1 Write the equation in the form ddx(yI(x))=I(x)Q(x), where I(x) is an integrating factor.

a
ddx(yex)=ex⋅1x
b
ddx(yx)=x⋅1x
c
ddx(y⋅2)=2⋅1x
d
ddx(yx2)=x2⋅1x
e
ddx(yln⁡x)=ln⁡x⋅1x
Submit
